- `web/src/components/HowWeKnowThis.astro` — **real binding fix the battery surfaced**: the dsrc-scoped `hwkt-sources` figure named `/provenance_summary/source_independence_count`, a field `sig.dossier-sources/1` does not emit; it now names `sources_with_published_claims` (the field the artifact carries — identical to the rendered value by construction via `dossierSourcesProvenance`).
